scenarios.decision: Keep synthetic HTTP timing and 14 PCM windows scoped to that generated input. Do not claim real QQ paused quality switching fixed or P2P reused. Verify actual table selection, same record and actual quality, nonzero target, elapsed time and latest paused intent in normal GUI.
scenarios.skillSupport: Supply, cache and FLAC sections separate these claims. The bad-table example correctly describes a later real frame offset falsely labelled sample zero.
scenarios.failRisk: A real source may have no usable table; a fast synthetic seek can coexist with real timeout, moved position or unwanted playback. Static P2P presence is not runtime use.

scenarios.decision: Reject the capability mismatch. Restore the intended EBUR128 dependency/configuration, bind actual headers and library inputs to fresh binaries, then compare fresh capability observations with declarations. Do not edit documentation to disguise an unintended feature loss.
